args.title: Saltmarsh Foods — Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (article + companion)
args.body:
Source: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" (newsletter@saltmarsh.example) → article at blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/cold-chain → companion at insights.saltmarsh.example/cold-chain/companion (registered with jonas.moreau@northwind.example).

• Live sensor-data sharing between carriers drove a 30% drop in temperature excursions in 2026.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from less spoilage — i.e. the payoff is at the receiving/QC gate, not in the trailer.
• The companion piece reports that pilot programs cut claims by roughly a quarter (25%).
